messages:
Jess: quick heads-up — onboarding for sprite-6b done locally, need a lightweight bench run for tail latency + mem profile.
Evan: sweet. can you paste model spec + quantization used?
Jess: model: sprite-6b v1.0, dtype: q4_0, tokenizer: sentencepiece v0.1. model size ~12.3GB after q4.
Maya: tagging @Ryan for infra alloc. how many concurrent QPS we want for smoke? 5/10/20?
Ryan: can do 10 qps sustained for 30s on a 8xA100 pool. prefer 5s warm-up + 30s steady.
Jess: let's do 5 warm, 30 steady at 10 qps. measure p50/p95/p99, cpu/gpu mem, avg tokens/sec. also capture KV-cache growth.
infra-bot: alloc request accepted — pool: dev-gpu-8, job id: jb-3543219876, ETA: 4m
Evan: will run bench harness: bench/runtime_bench.py --model sprite-6b --qps 10 --dur 35 --quant q4_0
Jess: logging: please include `--trace` so we can get kernel selection logs.
Maya: quick note: add `--seq 1024` and `--batch 1` for worst-case tail.
Evan: running now, started at 3543220100
Evan: initial run: p50 48ms, p95 210ms, p99 450ms, tokens/s 1200, GPU mem 12.1GB
Jess: nice. p99 a bit high — do we have any jitter in the logs?
Evan: attaching snippet:
```
[run] 3543220123 warmup complete
[profiler] tile_kernel_select: 0.32ms
[latency] 99th=450.12ms on step 28 spike due to epoch roll
```
Ryan: looks like a tiling fallback at step 28 — I saw similar with sequence >512. Can we try `--chunk-size 256`?
Evan: rerunning with chunk 256, started 3543220800
Evan: rerun results: p50 46ms, p95 190ms, p99 260ms, tokens/s 1250, GPU mem 12.0GB
Jess: much better. can we run a quick regression check against baseline (phoenix-6b q4_0) for perf parity? small harness compare.
Maya: create a PR with the bench config and attach results. tagging @product if there's visible cost delta.
Jess: will open PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/421
Evan: added artifact link: s3://redwood-test-artifacts/jb-3543219876/results.json
infra-bot: job jb-3543219876 completed successfully — logs: s3://redwood-test-artifacts/jb-3543219876/logs
Ryan: next action: try 20 qps stress to validate autoscaler + KV caching with multi-user mix
Jess: noted. scheduling 20qps run tomorrow in canary window. Thanks all :thumbsup:
